The user wants to mark compilation errors from the bottom console with a red line in the left margin (gutter) of the editor at the exact line of the error.

T1 found that errors are currently marked as text decorations (underline, color) in the text body, not in the gutter. The gutter is used for folds and git, but not diagnostics.
T2 found that line decorations only apply text styles (color, background, bold, underline) and there is no support for gutter icons/glyphs in the line decoration system. The gutter is managed separately in `helix dispatch` without integration of glyphs from line decorations.
T3 found the rendering of the left gutter (`Make Editor Panel`, `Render Editor Line`, `line gutter marker`, `fold gutter marker`, `helix gutter width`).

The user's request is to add a red line in the gutter for errors.
The investigation shows:
1. Errors are currently handled via text decorations.
2. The gutter rendering exists but is separate from the decoration system.
3. There is no existing mechanism to put icons/glyphs in the gutter based on line decorations.
